pages.text: 夜深了，月光照进咘咘的小房间。咘咘抱着小枕头，睡得香香的。突然，她翻了个身，嘴里嘟囔着：「烧烤……要吃烧烤……串串……」
pages.text_en: Late at night, moonlight streamed into Bubu's little room. Bubu hugged her pillow, sleeping soundly. Suddenly, she turned over and mumbled: "BBQ... I want BBQ... skewers..."

pages.text: 门口，Sam爸爸和Tina妈妈探头进来，听到咘咘的梦话，两人对视，忍不住笑了。爸爸小声说：「她在梦里点餐呢！」妈妈捂着嘴笑：「这孩子，连做梦都想着吃。」
pages.text_en: At the door, Dad Sam and Mom Tina peeked in. Hearing Bubu's sleep-talking, they looked at each other and couldn't help laughing. Dad whispered: "She's ordering food in her dreams!" Mom covered her mouth giggling: "This kid, even dreams about eating."

pages.text: 第二天早上，阳光洒进房间。咘咘揉揉眼睛醒来，打了个大大的哈欠。NOMI趴在床边问：「咘咘，你昨晚做了什么梦呀？」咘咘歪歪头：「嗯……我忘啦！」
pages.text_en: The next morning, sunlight poured into the room. Bubu rubbed her eyes and yawned big. NOMI leaned on the bedside and asked: "Bubu, what did you dream about last night?" Bubu tilted her head: "Hmm... I forgot!"

pages.text: 吃早餐的时候，Sam爸爸神秘地笑了笑：「咘咘，今天爸爸带你去一个特别的地方！」咘咘眼睛一亮：「什么地方？什么地方？」爸爸摇摇头：「到了就知道啦！」NONO在爸爸肩膀上拍拍翅膀，也一副神秘的样子。
pages.text_en: During breakfast, Dad Sam smiled mysteriously: "Bubu, today Dad's taking you to a special place!" Bubu's eyes lit up: "Where? Where?" Dad shook his head: "You'll see when we get there!" NONO flapped his wings on Dad's shoulder, also looking mysterious.

pages.text: 一家人出发啦！咘咘坐在妈妈怀里，好奇地东张西望。Coco走在旁边问：「Bubu, can you guess where we're going?」咘咘猜：「游乐场？动物园？冰淇淋店？」大家都摇头笑。
pages.text_en: The family set off! Bubu sat in Mom's arms, curiously looking around. Coco walked beside them and asked: "Bubu, can you guess where we're going?" Bubu guessed: "Playground? Zoo? Ice cream shop?" Everyone shook their heads and laughed.

pages.text: 到了！一个漂亮的户外烧烤花园，树上挂着彩灯，桌上摆满了食材。咘咘的眼睛瞬间亮了：「哇！烧烤！是烧烤！」她高兴得蹦了起来，耳朵一跳一跳的。
pages.text_en: They arrived! A beautiful outdoor BBQ garden with fairy lights hanging from trees and tables full of ingredients. Bubu's eyes instantly lit up: "Wow! BBQ! It's BBQ!" She jumped with joy, her ears bouncing up and down.

pages.text: Sam爸爸系上围裙，在烤架前忙活起来。咘咘搬了个小凳子站在旁边，拿着小夹子认真地翻玉米。爸爸夸她：「咘咘真厉害，是爸爸的小帮手！」NOMI在旁边帮忙递调料。
pages.text_en: Dad Sam put on an apron and got busy at the grill. Bubu brought a little stool to stand beside him, carefully flipping corn with small tongs. Dad praised her: "Bubu is amazing, Dad's little helper!" NOMI helped pass the seasonings nearby.

pages.text: Coco指着烤架上的食物，开心地教大家：「This is BBQ! Yummy! Look — corn! Chicken! Delicious!」咘咘跟着念：「B-B-Q！Yummy！」NONO站在Coco头上也跟着叫：「Yummy! Yummy!」
pages.text_en: Coco pointed at the food on the grill and happily taught everyone: "This is BBQ! Yummy! Look — corn! Chicken! Delicious!" Bubu repeated: "B-B-Q! Yummy!" NONO stood on Coco's head and chirped along: "Yummy! Yummy!"

pages.text: 大家围坐在一起，开开心心地吃烧烤。咘咘啃着鸡翅，嘴巴油亮亮的。NOMI抱着一根大玉米啃，嘴巴周围也全是油，尾巴开心地晃来晃去。Tina妈妈给咘咘擦嘴：「慢慢吃，不着急。」
pages.text_en: Everyone sat together, happily eating BBQ. Bubu nibbled on a chicken wing, her mouth all shiny. NOMI hugged a big corn cob, mouth all greasy too, tail swishing happily. Mom Tina wiped Bubu's mouth: "Eat slowly, no rush."

pages.text: 吃饱啦，咘咘靠在妈妈身上，拍拍小肚子。她突然好奇地问：「妈妈，为什么今天吃烧烤呀？」爸爸笑着说：「因为你昨晚做梦说想吃烧烤呀！」咘咘惊讶地张大了嘴：「真的吗？！」
pages.text_en: Full and satisfied, Bubu leaned against Mom and patted her little tummy. She suddenly asked curiously: "Mom, why are we having BBQ today?" Dad laughed: "Because you said you wanted BBQ in your dream last night!" Bubu opened her mouth wide in surprise: "Really?!"

pages.text: 咘咘开心得手舞足蹈：「哇！梦想成真了！我做梦说的话，爸爸妈妈都听到了！」她抱住爸爸妈妈：「爸爸妈妈最好了！」大家都笑了，NOMI感动得眼眶亮晶晶的。
pages.text_en: Bubu danced with joy: "Wow! My dream came true! Mom and Dad heard what I said in my dream!" She hugged her parents: "Mom and Dad are the best!" Everyone laughed, NOMI's eyes glistened with emotion.

pages.text: 回家的路上，夕阳把天空染成了橘红色。咘咘靠在爸爸背上，眯着眼睛说：「那我今晚要梦到去游乐场！」大家哈哈大笑。Coco说：「Dream big, Bubu! Dreams can come true!」咘咘闭上眼睛，嘴角带着甜甜的微笑，新的梦已经开始了。
pages.text_en: On the way home, the sunset painted the sky orange-red. Bubu leaned on Dad's back, squinting and said: "Then tonight I'll dream about going to the amusement park!" Everyone burst out laughing. Coco said: "Dream big, Bubu! Dreams can come true!" Bubu closed her eyes with a sweet smile — a new dream had already begun.
